title: Need(n't), don't need to and don't have to
summary: **Need** как обычный и как модальный глагол (**needn't, Need I...?**), отсутствие необходимости (**don't need to, don't have to, no need to**), разница с **mustn't** и конструкция **needs doing**.
ru:
## Два способа использовать need
**Need** бывает обычным глаголом (как want или like) и модальным (как can или must). От этого зависят отрицания и вопросы.
- **Обычный глагол:** need + to + инфинитив или need + существительное. Есть окончание -s, нужен do/does/did:
> You **need to** sign here. — Вам нужно подписать здесь.
> Does she **need** a visa? — Ей нужна виза?
> He **doesn't need to** know. — Ему необязательно знать.
- **Модальный глагол:** инфинитив **без to**, нет -s, **вопрос и отрицание без do**. Встречается только в отрицательных и вопросительных предложениях (а также после hardly, only, no one) и звучит формально, чаще по-британски:
> You **needn't** wait for me. — Можете меня не ждать.
> **Need** I fill in this form now? — Мне обязательно заполнять анкету сейчас?
> Nobody **need** know. — Никому не обязательно знать.
В утвердительных предложениях модального need нет: ~~You need go now.~~ → You **need to** go now.

## Отсутствие необходимости
Три конструкции говорят «не надо» и обычно взаимозаменяемы:
> You **needn't** come tomorrow. — Завтра приходить не нужно. (говорящий сам решает)
> You **don't need to** come tomorrow. — То же, нейтральнее.
> You **don't have to** come tomorrow. — Приходить не обязательно: нет такого правила или требования.
Оттенок: **needn't** часто означает «я, говорящий, разрешаю не делать», а **don't have to** — «нет правила или внешнего требования». **No need to / There's no need to** — безличный вариант: There's **no need to** shout. — Кричать не нужно.

## Mustn't — не то же самое!
**mustn't** — **запрет**, а **needn't / don't have to** — **отсутствие необходимости**:
> You **mustn't** use your phone here. — Здесь нельзя пользоваться телефоном.
> You **don't have to** use your phone. — Пользоваться телефоном необязательно.
Русская фраза «не надо» может переводиться и тем и другим, поэтому ошибка очень частая.

## Need + -ing
После **need** с вещью герундий имеет **пассивное значение**:
> The car **needs servicing**. = The car **needs to be serviced**. — Машину нужно обслужить.
> My shirt **needs ironing**. — Рубашку нужно погладить.

## Формальный стиль и обороты
- **It is not necessary (for you) to ...** — формально: It is not necessary for you to attend.
- **Need I say more?** — Нужно ли что-то добавлять? (риторический вопрос)
- Ответы: **Need I come? — Yes, you must. / No, you needn't.**

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~He needs not to go.~~ → He **needn't go.** / He **doesn't need to go.**
- ~~You mustn't come tomorrow~~ (если нужно сказать «не обязательно») → You **don't have to** come.
- ~~Does she need go?~~ → Does she **need to** go?
- ~~There is no need to apologising.~~ → There is no need **to apologise**.
en:
## Two ways to use need
**Need** can be an ordinary verb (like want) or a modal verb (like can or must). Negatives and questions depend on this.
- **Ordinary verb:** need + to-infinitive or need + noun, with -s and do/does/did:
> You **need to** sign here.
> Does she **need** a visa?
> He **doesn't need to** know.
- **Modal verb:** bare infinitive, no -s, no do in questions and negatives. It appears only in negative and interrogative sentences (and after hardly, only, nobody) and sounds formal, mostly British:
> You **needn't** wait for me.
> **Need** I fill in this form now?
> Nobody **need** know.
There is no modal need in positive sentences: ~~You need go now.~~ → You **need to** go now.

## No necessity
Three structures say 'it isn't necessary', and they are often interchangeable:
> You **needn't** come tomorrow. (the speaker decides)
> You **don't need to** come tomorrow. (neutral)
> You **don't have to** come tomorrow. (there is no rule or requirement)
**No need to / There's no need to** is impersonal: There's **no need to** shout.

## Mustn't is different!
**mustn't** = **prohibition**; **needn't / don't have to** = **no necessity**:
> You **mustn't** use your phone here.
> You **don't have to** use your phone.

## Need + -ing
After **need** with a thing the -ing form has a **passive meaning**:
> The car **needs servicing**. = The car **needs to be serviced**.
> My shirt **needs ironing**.

## Formal style and phrases
- **It is not necessary (for you) to ...** — It is not necessary for you to attend.
- **Need I say more?** — a rhetorical question.
- Answers: **Need I come? — Yes, you must. / No, you needn't.**

## Common mistakes
- ~~He needs not to go.~~ → He **needn't go.** / He **doesn't need to go.**
- ~~You mustn't come tomorrow~~ (meaning 'not necessary') → You **don't have to** come.
- ~~Does she need go?~~ → Does she **need to** go?
- ~~There is no need to apologising.~~ → There is no need **to apologise**.
structure:
## Формулы
| Тип | Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|---|
| обычный глагол | I **need to** go. | I **don't need to** go. | **Do** I **need to** go? |
| модальный | — | I **needn't** go. | **Need** I go? |
| 3-е лицо | She **needs to** go. | She **doesn't need to** go. / She **needn't** go. | **Does** she **need to** go? / **Need** she go? |
| с вещью | The car **needs** servicing. | The car **doesn't need** servicing. | **Does** it **need** servicing? |

## Сравнение: форма, значение, пример
| Форма | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| mustn't | запрещено | You **mustn't** park here. |
| needn't | можно не делать (решаю я) | You **needn't** park here. |
| don't need to | нет необходимости | You **don't need to** park here. |
| don't have to | нет требования | You **don't have to** park here. |
| no need to | безлично, «незачем» | There's **no need to** park here. |

## Отрицание и вопрос
> **Need** I come? — Yes, you **must**. / No, you **needn't**.
> **Do** I **need to** come? — Yes, you **do**. / No, you **don't**.
> Passive meaning: **needs doing** = **needs to be done**.

exercises.title: Need, needn't, don't have to
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужную форму. Допустимые варианты засчитываются.

items.text: You {{needn't|don't need to|do not need to|need not|don't have to|do not have to}} wait for me; I'll catch up later.
{{Need}} I fill in this form now?
She {{doesn't need to|does not need to|needn't|need not|doesn't have to|does not have to}} worry about money any more.
The garden needs {{watering|to be watered}} after such a dry week.
Do we {{need to|have to}} book a table in advance?
There's {{no}} need to shout; I can hear you perfectly well.
Employees {{don't have to|do not have to|don't need to|do not need to|needn't|need not}} wear a tie, but many choose to.

exercises.title: Подберите форму
exercises.instruction: Вставьте подходящее слово или форму. Допустимые варианты засчитываются.

items.text: This shirt {{needs}} ironing before the interview.
You {{mustn't|must not}} leave valuables in the car.
I {{needn't|don't need to|need not|do not need to|don't have to|do not have to}} tell you how important this is.
Does she {{need}} a visa to enter the country?
It is not {{necessary}} for you to attend the meeting.

items.q: You ___ come to the airport; I'll take a taxi.
___ wear a jacket to the dinner?
items.why: Модальный need: **Need I + инфинитив без to**; с do нужен **need to**.

items.q: He ___ to apply for a visa; he has a residence permit.
items.why: За пропуском идёт **to**, значит обычный глагол: **doesn't need to**.

items.q: В каком предложении need — модальный глагол?
items.why: Модальный need: нет -s, нет do, инфинитив без to.
Нельзя смешивать формы: **needn't go** или **doesn't need to go**.

options: Do I need to attend the meeting?

exercises.title: Перепишите
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя слово или конструкцию в скобках.

items.prompt: It's not necessary for you to wait. (needn't) → You ...
It is not necessary for her to come tomorrow. (doesn't need to) → She ...
answers: She doesn't need to come tomorrow.
She does not need to come tomorrow.

items.prompt: The windows are dirty; someone should clean them. (need + -ing) → The windows ...
Is it necessary for me to sign here? (modal need) → Need ...
It is unnecessary to apologise. (no need) → There ...
answers: There is no need to apologise.
There is no need to apologize.

items.prompt: I'm not obliged to pay for parking here. (don't have to) → I ...
answers: I don't have to pay for parking here.
I do not have to pay for parking here.

items.prompt: What don't you have to do at weekends?
items.sample: I don't have to get up early at weekends.

items.prompt: Tell a friend he needn't do something for you.
items.sample: You needn't pick me up; I'll take the bus.

items.prompt: What is something that needs doing in your home?
What mustn't people do in your workplace or school?
items.sample: Visitors mustn't enter the lab without a pass.

items.prompt: Write a formal question with 'Need I ...?'
items.sample: Need I bring any documents to the interview?

items.prompt: What do you not need to do if you work from home?
items.sample: I don't need to commute, and I needn't wear a suit.
